name: Supervisor::spawn_task

test_list.description: A task that panics once is run again; the panic never reaches the caller.
Each restart of a child fronting a WorkerKind publishes WorkerRestarted { worker, restarts } before the restarted task runs.
With jitter off the gaps between runs are min, 2*min, 4*min ... capped at max (paused time), never early and at most one 1 ms Tokio timer tick late. User-approved timer-contract correction.
A task that always fails is run 1 + max_restarts times, then given up: CircuitTripped and DeadLettered are published, the DLQ holds one letter, wait() returns IntensityExceeded.
After give-up, an hour of paused time produces no further runs.
A Temporary child that panics is not restarted.
A Transient child that returns Ok(()) is not restarted; a Permanent one is.
A TaskError of ErrorKind::Fatal is never retried: no restart, DLQ letter, CircuitTripped.
With OnExhausted::ShutdownSupervisor, giving up cancels the root token and stops the siblings.
stop() cancels the child's token; a cooperative child exits within grace (StopOutcome::Graceful) and is not restarted.
A child that ignores its token is aborted after grace (StopOutcome::Aborted).
stop() and wait() on an id the supervisor does not know return UnknownChild.
A panicking child does not affect a sibling; spawning, snapshot and stop keep working afterwards.
shutdown() stops every child (including one that ignores cancellation); the runtime reports zero alive tasks and every actor future was dropped; later spawns fail with ShuttingDown.
If the event store refuses appends, the child is still restarted and the loss is counted in the snapshot (events_lost).
Events published by the supervisor, folded into polaris_telemetry::Telemetry, produce worker_restarts, circuits_tripped and dead_letters counters.
A process worker returning an exit code is restarted at the 1 ms configured backoff and stops after the configured restart intensity.
Stopping a running worker calls the platform's graceful process-tree stop exactly once.
If async graceful stop is aborted by the supervisor deadline, the worker process guard synchronously force-stops the retained tree.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Name, restart policy, intensity, backoff, optional WorkerKind, exhaustion policy.

inputs.name: make
inputs.description: Factory called once per incarnation, inside the spawned task.

output_description: Handle to wait on / stop the supervised child.
